issues: Summary says regulations were destroyed “amid contention,” suggesting simultaneous events; the source gives no such chronology.
The visual inference of Jacob among the group as they recognize him as leader is consistent with the gathering and appointment, but the text does not specify how recognition looked or unfolded.
“People are angry with Nephi” and the reported daily angelic ministry are not explicitly a single moment; avoid depicting them as simultaneous.
The summary’s “At the end of the thirty-first year” is consistent with the transition in verse 21, but avoid implying the conversions and healings occurred at one specific moment.
